title: Repentance Verse
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true freedom and healing come from embracing our emotions, including difficult ones like guilt or anger, rather than trying to suppress or avoid them. Through a guided meditation on forgiveness, participants are encouraged to cultivate a sense of responsibility, compassion, and understanding for themselves and others, letting go of past harm and karmic conditioning without judgment. This practice aims to reveal the interconnectedness and emptiness that underlies all suffering, ultimately leading to a deeper understanding of reality and a more authentic way of being.
topics: breath as a tool for remorse
